title: BETAINV: 12 of 30 after the chain-exp landing, on the corpus it was validated on

upstream_anchor.section: PRODUCTION LANDING: the F2XM1 chain everywhere

status_plain: The current BETAINV figure is 12 of 30 with a worst residual of +5 ULP, reached by putting the chain exp through the beta forward. b14 is the corpus the inverter was validated on, with the held-out b19 captured separately, so this is a repair-target figure. The catalogue row is STALE here: it still prints 4/30 with worst +13, and 2/30 before that.
